description: Planetary K-index (0–9 geomagnetic activity scale) — recent observed 3-hour values with their NOAA G-scale equivalents and aurora-latitude guidance, plus the 3-day Kp forecast series. Kp is the primary driver of aurora visibility and geomagnetic storm severity. SWPC reports Kp in thirds and starts each G level at that level’s "minus" value: Kp 4.67 (5−) is G1, Kp 6.67 (7−) is G3 (aurora to ~50° geomagnetic), Kp 8.67 (9−) is still G4, and only Kp 9 is G5 extreme. Use noaa_spaceweather_get_conditions for a combined snapshot including storm scales; use this tool when you need the Kp time series or forecast detail.

window_days.description: Number of past days of observed Kp to return (1–7, default 1). Larger windows show trend context.

name: noaa_spaceweather_get_kp_index

currentKp.description: Latest observed Kp; 0 when the window has none.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `feed_unavailable`: SWPC feed returns 5xx or 429, times out, or answers with a body that is not parseable JSON. Retried for up to 45 seconds in total before failing. `feed_moved`: SWPC feed path returns a permanent 4xx (404, 410, 401, 403). Fails in one attempt. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

forecast.description: Kp forecast series: estimated and predicted entries, no observed history.

gScale.description: G level (0–5) derived from kp; matches noaaScale when stated.

noaaScale.description: NOAA scale the feed states, e.g. "G1"; null when none.

observed.description: Observed Kp in the window, oldest first.

auroraLatitude.description: Aurora guidance for this Kp, in geomagnetic latitude.

gScale.description: G level (0–5) for this Kp; G1 starts at 4.67, G5 at 9.

title: Get Kp Index
